name: SSH Password Brute Force (Correlation)
description: Detects multiple failed SSH authentication attempts from the same source IP within 300 seconds. Scope limitation: Volumetric single-source SSH password guessing.
explanation_template: Detected {match_count} failed SSH login attempts from source IP '{source_ip}' targeting host '{source_host}' (last user '{user}') within 300 seconds.
